name: Antigua and Barbuda
description: Antigua and Barbuda from its first peoples and the sugar plantations to emancipation, independence in 1981 and cricket.

checkpoints.name: Sugar colony
checkpoints.note: English settlers arrived in 1632 and built sugar plantations worked by enslaved Africans. The navy built its dockyard at English Harbour.

checkpoints.name: Freedom
checkpoints.note: Slavery ended in 1834. Vere Bird led the labour movement that won self-rule.

checkpoints.name: Independence
checkpoints.note: The islands became independent in 1981. Viv Richards became a cricket legend, and Hurricane Irma emptied Barbuda in 2017.
